platformNotice: ℹ️ You can resize or hide the lab guide anytime by sliding it left or right.

rules.title: H1 with guide ID
rules.description: First non-empty line must be `# <ID> <Title>` with the ID matching `HOL-\d{4}-\d{2}`.
rules.fixHint: Add `# HOL-XXXX-NN <Title>` as the first line of the guide.

rules.title: Platform notice
rules.description: The platform-notice line must appear verbatim within the first 3 non-empty lines.
rules.fixHint: Insert the exact notice line near the top of the guide (see format spec).

rules.title: TOC present, sequential numbering
rules.description: `## Table of Contents` must exist before the first module, and TOC entry numbers must be sequential 1..N.
rules.fixHint: Renumber TOC entries consecutively starting at 1.

rules.title: TOC anchors resolve
rules.description: Every TOC link must be a local anchor (`#…`) that resolves to an existing heading (GitHub anchor algorithm).
rules.fixHint: Regenerate the anchor from the actual heading text; anchors must not be external URLs.

rules.title: TOC coverage
rules.description: Every `##` section (except Table of Contents) appears in the TOC exactly once; no duplicate `##` headings.
rules.fixHint: Add missing sections to the TOC and rename duplicate headings.

rules.title: Lab Credentials block
rules.description: `### Lab Credentials:` (h3) must appear before the Introduction and contain at least one credential line.
rules.fixHint: Use `### Lab Credentials:` (heading level 3) with at least one Username/Password/FQDN/IP line.

rules.title: Target Audience block
rules.description: `### Target Audience` (h3) must exist before the Introduction.
rules.fixHint: Add `### Target Audience` with the audience list before the Introduction section.

rules.title: Introduction section
rules.description: `## Introduction` must exist (variants such as `Introduction Overview` or `Orientation` are drift).
rules.fixHint: Rename the section to exactly `## Introduction`.

rules.title: Introduction markers
rules.description: The Introduction must contain `**Duration:**` and `**Objective:**`.
rules.fixHint: Add a `**Duration:**` line (estimated minutes) and an `**Objective:**` intro with bullet objectives.

rules.title: Summary section
rules.description: `## Summary` must exist and appear after the last module (appendices may follow the Summary).
rules.fixHint: Add a standalone `## Summary` section after the final module (do not fold it into a module heading).

rules.title: Module headings sequential
rules.description: Body sections must match `## Module <N>: <Title>` with N sequential from 1. `## Phase …` and other variants are drift.
rules.fixHint: Rename body sections to `## Module <N>: <Title>` and keep numbering sequential.

rules.title: Back-to-top link
rules.description: Every `##` section ends with `[Back to top](#table-of-contents)`.
rules.fixHint: Add `[Back to top](#table-of-contents)` (optionally followed by `***`) at the end of the section.

rules.title: Image syntax
rules.description: Every image line must be `![Image](/ImageProxy?filename=<uuid>/<file> "Click to enlarge"){data-modal=true}` or `<< INSERT SCREENSHOT: <desc> >>`.
rules.fixHint: Use the ImageProxy form for uploaded images, or the `<< INSERT SCREENSHOT: description >>` placeholder.

rules.title: Inline command shellcheck
rules.description: Extracted inline commands (tab/4-space indented, backtick-wrapped) must pass shellcheck. Parse errors are errors; style warnings are W014.
rules.fixHint: Fix the flagged command (quote variables, drop unused pipes) or verify the line is not a command.

rules.title: Callout style consistency
rules.description: Non-standard or mixed callout variants detected (e.g. `**Tip!**`, `**Use Case!` alongside standard forms).
rules.fixHint: Use standard callouts: `**Tip:**`, `**Note:**`, `⚠️ **Important:**`, `**Use Case:**`, `> ✅ **Checkpoint:**`.

rules.title: Long section without subheading
rules.description: A `##` section exceeds 400 lines with no `###` subheading (pacing risk).
rules.fixHint: Split the section into `###` sub-sections (e.g. per exercise or concept).

rules.title: Summary ordering drift
rules.description: `## Summary` appears before all modules are complete.
rules.fixHint: Move `## Summary` after the final module.

rules.title: Missing checkpoint
rules.description: A module has 3 or more command steps but no `> ✅ **Checkpoint:**` block.
rules.fixHint: Add a `> ✅ **Checkpoint:**` line stating the verifiable end state.

rules.title: Image checklist mismatch
rules.description: Module plan image checklist and the module's actual images/placeholders disagree (missing or extra).
rules.fixHint: Reconcile the module plan image checklist with the screenshots actually present.

rules.title: Credential/URL drift
rules.description: A credential or URL in a module body is not listed in the Lab Credentials block.
rules.fixHint: List every host/credential used in the guide in the Lab Credentials block (single source of truth).

rules.title: Raw HTML in guide
rules.description: Raw HTML (`
rules.fixHint: Remove raw HTML; use the guide image syntax for images.

rules.title: Unfinished-marker tokens
rules.description: `TODO`, `TBD`, or `FIXME` tokens found (image placeholders are excluded).
rules.fixHint: Resolve or remove the marker before publishing.

rules.title: Inline command shellcheck style
rules.description: A shellcheck style warning (not a parse error) on an extracted inline command.
rules.fixHint: Address the shellcheck finding (quote variables, avoid unused pipes) or verify the line is not a command.

rules.title: shellcheck not installed
rules.description: shellcheck binary not found; inline command checks were skipped.
rules.fixHint: Install shellcheck (apt) for full L014 coverage.
